International Cheese Federation Certifications
This page provides an archive of articles from the International Cheese Federation, focusing on various professional certification programs offered. Topics include judge accreditation, food safety (HACCP), sensory evaluation, cheesemonger credentials, affinage, and fundamental cheese knowledge, detailing what each certification covers and its requirements.

The two scorecards a judge learns to read
